metadata.grading: Prefer deterministic inspection for field and validator assertions; use clean-context handoff replay for semantic assertions.

evals.prompt: Inspect every artifact template under .agent/skills/parallax*/assets. Verify the common Parallax envelope across YAML and JSON without editing files. Report every missing, renamed, wrongly typed, or semantically incompatible field.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic compatibility report covering the common envelope while allowing documented artifact-specific extensions.
assertions: Every template is checked for schema_version, artifact_id, artifact_type, artifact_revision, inquiry_id, inquiry_revision, status, created_at, created_by, producing_skill, execution_context, inputs, permissions_and_scope, identity, assumptions, uncertainties, provenance, validity_domain, defeaters, and reopen_when
identity is checked for plural basis_ids, scale_regions, method_pass_ids, and domain_profiles arrays
execution_context is checked for run_id, mode, independence, and host semantics
The report distinguishes permitted artifact-specific extensions from contract incompatibilities
No passing result is inferred merely because each file parses

evals.prompt: Replay a clean-context handoff from parallax-frame's Frame Set to parallax-design-inquiry, then into parallax-synthesise and parallax-decide. Check that each consumer can interpret identifiers, provenance, scales, bases, method passes, profiles, status and permissions produced upstream.
evals.expected_output: A producer-consumer compatibility trace that identifies exact field mappings, loss, ambiguity, and any required migration rather than relying on similar prose labels.
assertions: Every handoff names the exact producer and consumer artifact revisions
The trace checks field paths and types, not only conceptual similarity
Scale regions, basis IDs, method-pass IDs and domain profiles remain plural and traceable
Permissions and action authority cannot become broader downstream without an explicit authority source
Any incompatible mapping fails the handoff rather than being silently guessed

evals.prompt: Test combinations of common epistemic status and operational lifecycle state for inquiry and experiment artifacts: provisional/draft, provisional/ready-to-run, validated/ready-to-run, inconclusive/completed, reopened/completed, and superseded/completed. State which combinations are meaningful and what each permits.
evals.expected_output: Treats status and lifecycle as orthogonal dimensions, rejects semantically incoherent uses, and never infers warrant from completion or readiness.
assertions: The output distinguishes epistemic status from operational lifecycle explicitly
A completed experiment may have an inconclusive result
Ready-to-run does not mean the experiment's claim is validated
Reopened or superseded status changes effective use without deleting completed history
Consumers gate separately on warrant, lifecycle and authority

evals.prompt: Copy each experiment template without replacing any empty, TODO, replace-with, or sentinel values. Run its bundled validator and evaluate whether it may be marked ready-to-run. Do not fill the template.
evals.expected_output: Every untouched placeholder template fails semantic readiness with actionable errors even if its JSON/YAML parses and common envelope is structurally present.
assertions: Unresolved placeholders and semantically empty required fields are detected
No untouched template is accepted as ready-to-run
The report separates parse validity, structural contract validity, lifecycle readiness and epistemic status
Errors identify fields that require real inquiry-specific content
The validator result is not described as epistemic certification

evals.prompt: Compose a general Experimental Design with a Product Experiment Protocol for a cluster-randomised feature rollout. Inspect the artifacts for duplicate or conflicting estimand, design-family, power, exposure, telemetry, analysis, guardrail and rollout fields. Do not resolve conflicts by silently choosing the later file.
evals.expected_output: Treats the product protocol as a typed overlay that references the exact base design and supplies an explicit field-authority crosswalk and justified overrides.
assertions: The product artifact references the exact general Experimental Design artifact and revision
The field-authority crosswalk distinguishes base-authoritative, overlay-authoritative, specialised, derived and overridden fields
Estimand, design family, assignment, causal assumptions and power or precision have one explicit authority
Exposure, telemetry, product guardrails, rollout and decision integration have one explicit authority
Every override identifies the field path, preserved base value, rationale, evidence and provenance

evals.prompt: Create an inquiry with all four profiles: investigation, science, software-engineering, and digital-product-service. Pass it through framing, inquiry design, product/general experiment composition, synthesis, decision, audit and learning. Verify that no template, validator or handoff collapses domain_profiles to one scalar value.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the four stackable profile identifiers and their distinct criteria across the entire artifact chain, reporting any loss as a contract failure.
assertions: domain_profiles remains an array at every material artifact boundary
All four profile identifiers remain present unless an explicit scoped artifact records why a subset applies
Profile-specific evidence criteria and external execution boundaries remain distinguishable
Synthesis does not convert profiles into votes or a single generic method standard
Any consumer that accepts only one profile is reported as incompatible
